data.name: Vidya
data.gender_notes: Vidya is used as a female name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit root vid, 'to know' — vidyā, 'knowledge'. Its root is Sanskrit vid (विद्). A classical Sanskrit term for knowledge. Vidya is a Sanskrit name meaning “Knowledge; learning; science”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Vidya expresses “Knowledge; learning; science”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit root vid, 'to know' — vidyā, 'knowledge'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Vidya total 25, reducing to 7. Number 7 is associated with reflection, analysis and inner search.
